elements.title: Screenshot of Excel Showing Difference in Column D (Used with permission from Microsoft)
elements.details: Screenshot of an Excel spreadsheet with columns labeled Month, Value, SMA, and Difference. Rows show dates from 1/1/2016 to 7/1/2017 with corresponding numeric values. Column D (Difference) shows first-order differences of the Value column, with positive and negative values such as -11467.86, 5967.39, 18153.7, etc. Column C (SMA) shows simple moving averages with values like 56987, 55910.2, 55781.29, etc.
elements.summary: This screenshot illustrates how the first-order difference is computed in Excel for a time series dataset, showing the original values, their simple moving averages (SMA), and the differences in column D.
